name: seeu-mobile
description: SeeU 安卓/苹果 App 外壳（Capacitor），页面来自 ../app

scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
